Title: Minor issues with Legacies of Blood

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
Uzoma is repeated in both the starters and the boosters.

Kisha Bhimji does not appear in the boosters or starters.

-------------------

Fae Contortion has the background of an action card.
Its effects are: Reflex, Combat, and Action Modifier.

-------------------

The layout appears to be significantly consistent!

Great Job Scott.

Thank you.

Messages.Body:

There is an explanation on the WW site.

"Note: Uzoma (a vampire from the Osebo starter) was accidentally

Messages.Author: talonz

>

I find the multi discipline cards to very inconsistent in one respect;
how the discipline symbols are listed on the left margin of the card.

some vice versa. This appears to be split roughly 50/50 across the
set.

Which makes hand and collection sorting very awkward if you organize by

eliminated. Listing the outferior symbol over the inf/sup just as the
card text does would seem to be preferable personally.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Emiliano Imeroni wrote:
> talonz wrote:
>>I find the multi discipline cards to very inconsistent in one respect;
>>how the discipline symbols are listed on the left margin of the card.
>>Some have the outferior discipline symbol above the inf/sup symbol, and
>>some vice versa. This appears to be split roughly 50/50 across the
>>set.
>
> What "inconsistency" are you talking about? ALL of the
> bloodline-discipline
> cards in LoB have the bloodline-discipline symbol shown above the one
> of
> the outferior.

Correct.

> Cards that genuinely require TWO disciplines (such as Inspire
> Greatness,
> Muricia's Call, Eye of Unforgiving Heaven, Glare of Lies, Truth of
> Blood)
> have the symbols in alphabetical order (up to down).

Correct.

Multi-Discipline cards have the Disciplines in alphabetical order.

Split-Discipline cards have the Disciplines in "primary"-"secondary"
order, when such a distinction exists. When all Disciplines are
used "equally", alphabetical order is used to break the ties (e.g.,
in Anarch 3-way cards).

> Looks pretty consistent to me...

Thanks.
